identity.realm: None, and never properly offered. A rootmarch clears the fourth gate on stored sap alone and is anatomically finished there, but the body path was never the question here, because this species has qi and mind both open. What closed it is a book-keeping rule: a provisioning entry that advanced would stop being a reserve, and the single discipline a reserve store has is that stock is not advanced. She was seated for the store's first training year at nineteen and has three written refusals in her file, all in her own hand, which is the only part of the file nobody else wrote.

appearance.presentation: A banking term that has been opened and not yet reclassified. She is the only item in the provisioning yard that cannot be put back in the store, and she is described to a stranger by a clerk using the word line before the word woman, in that order, and then corrected, too late.
appearance.age: A term rather than a count. She was entered at establishment and never entered again, so her age on the store's card is the length of a banking season and her age in her own body is a decade of no light. Rootmarch years are dates in a ledger, which is why nobody at the store can say how old she is and why she has stopped correcting them.
appearance.build: A woody column on a root foot with three sap columns under bark that has gone the grey of planed board, elongated and pale from a decade without a growing season, with a photosynthetic flank that has the pattern of a plant that has only ever seen one lamp. Narrow through the crown, broad at the base, and carrying her mass low in the way a root problem carries it.
appearance.complexion: Store-pale over everything, with the ochre sap flush surviving only in a narrow band low in the trunk where the store kept a lamp burning over her for nine years. There is a hard line across her at the height of that band and everything above it is the colour of stored grain.
appearance.hair: A crown that never got its season: short, pale, uneven, and stretched thin toward no light at all. It is not cuttable without costing her a season of vigour, so it stays, and it is the one part of her that visibly did not finish.
appearance.eyes: Amber, slow, and contracted by a decade of a single lamp. She has never seen a bright room and has been taken into one twice. The eyes stop in the middle of a turn rather than completing it, which a clerk has mistaken for inattention and a doctor has mistaken for damage.
appearance.palette: The store's own two values, store-black and ration ochre, with one living colour she cannot get rid of and has no use for: chlorophyll green along the flanks, where the light got at her. It is the only saturated thing on the card and the only part of her that photographs as alive.
appearance.attire: Banking dress, which is not clothing. A waxed bark-cloth shell lashed over a shoulder yoke with the store's hitch at her hip, a house-issue tally disc on a thong at her throat that is not hers and is not removable, and the rim of a shallow tray of her own bed — lifted out of the store with her, carried at a hand's width from the root foot at all times, and the only thing on her person that anybody has ever verified against a register line.
appearance.marks: Two ring scars at the wrists where the sap columns were clamped for the banking and the clamp was not taken off for a year, and a branded tally low on the bark at the root crown where the store marks a line it intends to draw on.
appearance.bearing: Still in a way that reads as held rather than calm. She takes the posture the store stored her in and has not updated it, and will hold a position well past the point where holding it has anything to say. Her crown turns toward whatever is warm and away from whoever is reading.

canon.role_in_story: A provisioning house banks a rootmarch because a rootmarch can be sealed in a dark field and live for months, which makes it a famine reserve and a hostage in equal measure, and a grain store is neither. Thura is that reserve, entered as a quantity against a shortage, and the shortage ended while she was under the floor. Her line has been open in the register ever since, because closing it needs an authority nobody at that house has: you may write down a delivery, and you cannot write down a delivery that arrives alive and asks you to change its heading. So the house carries a reserve on its books that is standing in the yard asking to be reclassified, and every clerk who handles her entry handles a woman by the rules for a sack.
canon.first_appearance: First seen in the provisioning yard beside the open store hatch with the tray of her own bed on a hand-barrow, waiting for the clerk who wrote her line to finish arguing with the clerk who countersigned it, and entirely aware that she is the only matter in the yard whose argument is being had over her.
canon.lore:
The species was made upward from a mycorrhizal food crop by generations of selection for holding a harvest rather than for yield, so it can be sealed in a dark field and live for months. There is no mouth in the ordinary sense: intake happens through root plates at the foot, and light is received along the flanks rather than by an eye, which means a store's single lamp is a full-spectrum input and a decade of it is a growing season that never turned. It carries three sap columns and no organ pairs. Sap branches and does not pair, so there is no channel running between distinct pairs, the yin-organ gate demands one, and the ladder ends at the fourth realm on stored sap alone. Wood is not muscle and there is nothing in the frame to temper, so the body path is shut outright. Qi it takes from soil unusually well and the mind is open because a plant lineage is never hurried.

None of that is why she is uncultivated. A reserve is banked to be spent later and the spending a reserve exists for is not qi, it is a season: the shortage comes, the store opens one line, and the line is eaten. That is the whole arithmetic, and it is why a store will bank a body that cannot move rather than a person it could send somewhere. Cultivating her would spend the sap she is holding, and the sap she is holding is the only thing about her anybody has ever wanted. She has sat for the store's first training year at nineteen and written three refusals since, all of them in the form the store itself uses for a line it intends to draw on: name, term, date, and a statement of what the line will not be used for.
history: Fruited in the third season of her life in a household's field as banking stock, and rooted in the fourth, which is the dangerous part of a rootmarch's establishment and not the part anybody writes on the card.

Was cut into the store's reserve the following autumn at a banking term of nine years, entered against a famine forecast the quartermaster's office published, with the register line headed in the hand of the clerk who took the delivery.

Spent the whole banking term sealed in the dark with a lamp over the sap band and nothing else, held at the fourth gate the entire time, because there was nothing in the store to advance on and a line that advances is not a reserve.

Was opened in the first week of a year the shortage had already been beaten by a different road, and found to be standing rather than spoiled, which is the correct result and is not what the forecast had bought.

Was carried out into the yard on a hand-barrow with a tray of her own bed because a rootmarch lifted from its bed is a stored harvest walking and she knows it, and has been there since, being the only line on that register that has never been closed and cannot be closed by any clerk in the building.

personality.summary: Patient on a scale that is not stoic but genuinely unbothered, because a body that was sealed in the dark for nine years has had a very long time to stop finding anything urgent. What she is careful about is bookkeeping, with an intensity that catches people out: she has read her own file more times than anyone has written in it, she knows which clerk wrote which line, and she has come to hold the register's grammar as a more reliable account of her life than anybody's memory of her.
traits: knows the contents of her own file exactly and can recite the sequence of hands that have written in it
treats a classification as a physical object with a location and an owner, and asks where hers is kept
does not distinguish between being owed something and being owed a heading, and has decided the second is worth more
has no urgency at all about anything except paperwork and has arranged her entire personality around that
carries the tray of her own bed the way a person carries a photograph and has never been asked to explain it
mannerisms: stops mid-turn when something warm happens, and completes the turn several seconds later without acknowledging the gap
quotes her own register line verbatim before answering any question about herself
keeps one hand on the tray rim at all times, including in the bath and in the store hatch
answers a question by naming the term and the heading rather than by naming a feeling
counts things aloud when she is anxious, and the things she counts are dates
motivations: wants the line struck and the heading rewritten from reserve to resident, and has been told four times that this is not a thing a store does
wants somebody with authority to say out loud that a quantity arrived alive, because that sentence is the whole of her case
wants the tray of her own bed entered on the register as belonging to her, so that the only verified thing she owns is not carried informally
wants to know whether the nine years counted as service, and has worked out privately that nobody can answer without admitting the seal
flaws: has made the register's grammar her own speech, so she now describes herself in the third person and in the present tense of a store
is more offended by the classification than by anything that happened during the nine years, which is not the complaint she would have made in the dark
cannot conceive of a future that is not a term of service, and has never had to conceive of one
will refuse an offer in the store's own form every time, because the form is the argument, and has not noticed that this makes her very easy to file
personality.voice: Level, unhurried, and entirely in the register's idiom. She uses the store's headings for herself and her own condition — term, line, heading, draw — and has to be asked to stop. Gives a date and the hand that wrote it, in that order, and will correct the order if given the other way round.
taboos: will not be described as stock, and will correct the word politely and then produce the line that uses it
will not set the tray down, and has refused to explain why on four separate occasions
will not be told she is free, because free is a heading she has never been given and does not intend to accept informally
will not cultivate, and has never once explained the arithmetic to anybody who did not ask for it in writing

relationships.note: A sap-driven body that flowers, three sap columns and no organ pairs, seeded and established and then sealed in the dark for nine years and still standing at the end of it. Everything the store can do to her and nothing the store can do with her comes out of that one sentence about her anatomy.

The plains' one institution that keeps a register of what a body contains and calls it burial. It works because the dead are opened and the register records how much came out. Thura is the same arithmetic with the body still in it, and the store's clerks use the same headings, which is the only reason anyone there thinks of her as a quantity rather than as a person. She has read the burial register. She found her own heading in the margin.

A mortuary college that keeps one sealed case for every death it cannot certify, and the cases accumulate because certifying a death needs a body and the frames keep producing the record without the body. That is her case exactly with the polarity reversed: she is the body the record cannot close, and she has thought so every time she has been taken past a mortuary door.

A fire-affinity population taken for a decade, which is the disaster that made a living reserve worth banking at all. Her line was opened against a later and smaller forecast of the same shape, and the register does not carry the two forward of each other. She is the reason the store believes in reserves and the reason the store has no procedure for one that returns.

The dosing rule that decides who gets the herb first, sorted by need, on ground that regrows only as fast as it is grazed. A body that outlasts the season is not neediest under that rule and never has been, which is the plain arithmetic of why she can be held in a store and never called for. She can still read a dosing table better than anyone in that house and it has never once been entered against her line.

Medicine, feed and calories in one plant, contested between the plain households and the guild that has to feed its own crews. The plainstoll answer is that the commons answers in a famine by drawing on the standing crop. She is that standing crop, in a box, and the two sides of that dispute have never once sent anybody to look at her.

reference_stats.summary: Cannot fight, cannot travel once rooted, and has not been asked to do either. What she has is the one property that makes a living reserve possible at all: sealed in the dark with no water, no light worth the name and no conversation, she came out at the end of the term standing. Every other body the setting records would have been spent by that, and the store bought a nine-year term for her because of it. She is also the only item on that register that has improved while being held.
strengths: outlasts a sealed dark term that would kill every other body on the plains, which is the entire basis of her price
cannot be hurried, flanked, or frightened, because none of those are operations a rooted body supports and she has had nine years to stop offering any
has nothing worth stealing and nothing to spend, so a raid on the store costs the store a term rather than costs her a life
reads her own file better than anybody who wrote it, and has every date in it by hand
will not be moved by an offer, because the offer has to be written and writing it creates the record she wants
weaknesses: cannot move once rooted, so every plan that includes her is a plan that has to be brought to her, including her own
no tissue to temper, so the body path is closed outright and the attempt disperses rather than fails
no heart and no kidney analogue, so there is no channel to close and the fourth gate is a permanent wall
cannot read a bright room and has been taken into two, which is the whole of her combat-relevant limitation expressed as eyesight
is classified as a quantity, and will act on that classification by refusing offers in the store's own form
reference_stats.combat_read: There is no exchange available and she will not attempt one. A rooted body with a shoulder yoke on it is not a combatant, so the only approach is to make the situation urgent and hope she treats urgency as a delivery date — she will not; she will ask whether the delivery has been countersigned. Bring siege rather than a strike. The single blow that lands on her is the ground she is standing in, and she has solved that by never putting it down: she carries it, and the tray is the one thing on her that a clerk has ever verified against a line.
notes: No figure is quoted for her anywhere, because the register records a line and a line has one heading and no body attached to it. She is the only entry in that book with a pulse.
The store's training year seats everything it banks, and she has sat it three times. She is the only line in that house that has refused in writing rather than simply never being sent for.

art.palette_notes: Store-black and ration ochre carry the figure, with chlorophyll green along the photosynthetic flanks as the only living value and the only thing on her that looks lit from inside. Light is drawn as two sources and they never agree: a single hard lamp somewhere above and behind, which is the lamp she was banked under, and a weak cold wash from the open hatch she has been brought out into for the first time. Ink contours heavy at the root crown and the tray rim, dissolving into pale unfinished line at the crown of the head, which is the part of her that never got a season.
